author: Myeongjin Kang
quantifiers: For every nonzero complete commutative Noetherian local ring (R,m,k) of characteristic p, with d=dim R>=0.
For every finite free R-complex F concentrated in homological degrees 0 through d, whose homology modules all have finite length and H_0(F) is nonzero.

definitions.e_m(R): Hilbert-Samuel multiplicity of the maximal ideal m.
definitions.beta_i^R(F): dim_k H_i(k tensor_R F); equals the ith rank of a minimal free representative.
definitions.chi_infty^R(F): lim_{n->infinity} p^(-nd) sum_j (-1)^j length_R H_j(Phi_R^n F), with Phi_R^n the Frobenius scalar extension.

new_operation: Wider sufficient cohomological-root windows and cardinal interpolation isolate every homological rank, preserving the source blowup sign.
paid_operations: source normalized-length and integral root-bundle machinery
not_claimed: ordinary Euler characteristic bound in arbitrary local rings
